main_text.p: tium alieni aggresforem conde-mnauit, & ex urbe patria expul-sum relegauit. Hæc Acta Conci-lij auctoritati Pontificiæ innixa in ea dignatione fuere, ut Octauæ Synodi Oecumenicæ locum occu-parint, & apud Græcos ipsos no-men tenuerint Octaui Concilij Ge-neralis. Quid interim gesserit Pho.tius, & quibus machinis decreta Nicolai, & illius successoris Adria-ni infirmare conatus fuerit, fuse profequuntur tum Græci, cum La-tini Historici. Ijs tamen cum ob-niterentur Pontifices, licet ille plu-rimum laboraret, nihil profecit, donec Ignatius manfit in vita; quo demortuo, Sanctabareni malis arti-bus, & Photij commentario de Ba-filij Imperatoris sanguinis propa-ge, circumuentus Basilius procu-

page.notes: The printed hyphen after "Pho" is rendered as a period in the scan ("Pho."); transcribed as printed. The word "fuse" and the words "parint", "manfit" are as printed. The catchword "ra-" stands below the last line at the right, beside the ornament.
